overall: One continuous read of the whole passage in one take, as a person from Texas who knows this subject and is explaining plainly what the university published. Plainspoken and human. Not a news anchor, not a documentary hush, not an explainer's bright lift. Begin at once with the water in the yard, with no build-up. The energy moves in drops as well as lifts: a lift on the station, a clear lift on the turn where the chip judges the water itself, steady through the radio ranges, level on the map, and lowest and most certain on the limit and the close. Carry every sentence join with no reset of pitch or pace. Say UT as two letters, U and T. Say AI as two letters, A and I, both times it appears. Say San Antonio the Texas way, with the stress on the TOH in Antonio, not the Spanish stress. Read ninety eight point eight two percent as one number, with eight and two spoken together. Say its as an unstressed possessive, never it's. Give a breath, never a hold, only at the clause joins named in each line and at the full stops. Do not put any silence between sentences, because the film is cut to this recording. Keep one steady, brisk conversational pace from the first word to the last, about the speed of a person reading aloud to a colleague, and do not slow down for the limit or the close. Let the final phrase settle with no upturn at the end.
performance_arc: Plain and close over the flooded yard, quicker through the station and its marks, a lift on the chip turn, steady through the radio ranges, then slower and level on the validation figure and the close.

lines.text: UT San Antonio says some people could have ankle-deep water in their yard before a flood warning sounds on their phone.
lines.intent: Set the stake at once, in step with the picture: the water can reach a yard before the phone warns anyone. The sentence is the university's framing, so it is delivered as what the university says, with could have kept as a possibility.
lines.energy: The opening line. Start at working level and move straight into the picture, with no hush and no build. Keep it below the lift that follows, and let the pitch settle as the sentence reaches the phone.
lines.pause_after: A breath at the join after yard, where the clause ends and before begins, with no hold. The rest of the sentence runs on. Full stop at phone, a normal breath, and the next line joins with no reset.
lines.reason: Orient. The water tops the curb and climbs the post at s1-event-1, the boots and the dark phone show at s1-event-2, and the late banner at s1-event-3 is the picture of before a flood warning sounds. The stress lands on the late banner.

lines.text: So its researchers built a flood station that charges itself from light and needs no cell tower.
lines.intent: The turn from the yard to the answer. So marks the consequence of the flood gap: the researchers built a station that powers itself and needs no tower. It is a design the university describes, not a station standing in a street.
lines.energy: The first clear lift, plain and forward and not triumphant. So opens low and joins the yard without a reset, then the energy rises on the station and holds through light.
lines.pause_after: No break inside the sentence, so the phrase runs from So through light and into needs no cell tower. Full stop at tower, a normal breath, and the next line carries straight on.
lines.reason: Reveal. The station is shown at s2-event-1. The stress lands on the panel and the battery bar at s2-event-2, which is the charge the phrase names. The needs no cell tower clause is carried by the dashed line that stops short at s2-event-3. See flag G9.

lines.text: Four optical sensors at different heights watch the water, along with rain, temperature, humidity and light.
lines.intent: Name what the station watches. The count and the heights are what the picture makes visible, so the stress sits on the heights. The readings are said as the other things it also watches, in one even run.
lines.energy: A step down from the lift, quicker and even in tempo, at the speed of a working explanation. No extra lift on the list.
lines.pause_after: A breath at the comma after water, the clause join, with no hold. The list of readings runs on with no breath inside it. Full stop at light, a normal breath, and the next line joins with no reset.
lines.reason: Explain. The four lenses at four heights are on screen at s3-event-1, which is where the stress falls. The brown water crossing the marks at s3-event-2 and the weather lamps at s3-event-3 carry the rest of the sentence.

lines.text: A small chip on the station runs the AI itself, so it judges flood risk without a central server.
lines.intent: The turn of the film. The chip runs the AI on the station itself, so the judgment is local. The stress goes on the one claim the picture backs with a dark server and no line running to it.
lines.energy: The clear lift of the middle, the discovery point. Firm and forward on runs the AI itself, keep the pitch up through so it judges flood risk, and let the server phrase land at the same level.
lines.pause_after: A breath at the comma after itself, the clause join, with no hold. The so it judges flood risk phrase runs on into without a central server. Full stop at server, a normal breath, and the next line joins with no reset.
lines.reason: Reveal. The readings reach the chip at s4-event-1 and the amber risk lamp lights at s4-event-2, so the local judgment is seen before it is named. The server outline stays dark with no line at s4-event-3, which is the picture the stressed phrase answers. See flag G3.

lines.text: When the risk rises, a radio signal can carry more than a half-mile through city streets, and up to five miles in open country, to a hub.
lines.intent: Give the signal's reach as the university describes the radio, in two ranges and one destination. Each range keeps its qualifier, more than on the city range and up to on the open-country range. To a hub is where the whole carry ends.
lines.energy: Steady and even through the ranges, a step below the turn, neither rising nor falling. The two ranges sit at one level, with the upper bound as the only stress.
lines.pause_after: A breath at the comma after rises, and a breath at the comma after streets, both clause joins, with no hold. A breath at the comma after country, before to a hub. Full stop at hub, a normal breath, and the next line joins with no reset.
lines.reason: Explain. The rings leave the antenna at s5-event-1 and pass the more than a half mile tag at s5-event-2, said at the same level and without stress so it does not read as the bigger claim. The stress on up to five miles lands on the five-mile tag and the hub mast at s5-event-3. This is the longest sentence in the passage and the most likely line to run long. See flag K2.

lines.text: At the hub, a second, larger AI model draws a map of how flooding could spread, for emergency responders.
lines.intent: Say what the second, larger model does at the hub: it draws a map of how flooding could spread, for responders. Could stays on spread, so the map shows a possibility the model draws, not a flood that has already happened.
lines.energy: Level and plain, a step below the radio line. Report it as the design's described output, with no lift on the model and no lift on responders.
lines.pause_after: A breath at the comma after hub, which follows a noun. A breath at the comma after spread, the clause join, with no hold, and no breath after for. Full stop at responders, a normal breath, and the next line joins with no reset.
lines.reason: Explain. The hub dashboard and the station dots arrive at s6-event-1, the shaded paths spread at s6-event-2, where the stress on could spread lands, and the risk zones and responder tag come at s6-event-3. The picture at s6-event-1 shows several stations feeding the hub, which conflicts with the later no installation line. See flag P2.

lines.text: The university reports ninety eight point eight two percent validation accuracy from early assessments after training, and no field result.
lines.intent: The limit at the heart of the film. State the university's own figure with its qualifiers in one run, then the limit: no field result. The figure is measured and flat, neither celebrated nor doubted. The limit is the quietest and most certain part of the passage.
lines.energy: The figure runs at one even level, flat and measured. The limit then drops to the lowest energy in the passage, certain and level, with the least movement of pitch in the whole read. Keep it low through the last word.
lines.pause_after: No break in the figure, from the number through validation accuracy and from early assessments after training. A breath at the comma after training, the clause join, with no hold. And no field result runs straight to the full stop, then a normal breath into the closing line.
lines.reason: Qualify. The figure fills at s7-event-1 and the after training tag pins under it at s7-event-2, so the qualifiers are spoken with the figure they qualify. The stress on no field result lands on the blank card and the none reported stamp at s7-event-3, the picture of the missing record. See flag G6.

lines.text: It names no town that has installed one. Deployment is still the goal.
lines.intent: Two sentences in one file line. First the second limit, said level and plain: the university names no town that has installed one. Then the closing answer as its own phrase: deployment is still the goal. Still carries not yet, so it is the stress and the last thing the viewer hears.
lines.energy: Level with the end of the limit line through the first sentence, low and plain. The closing phrase settles to the same low, certain level as the limit and falls to the end, with still carrying the open state and no upturn.
lines.pause_after: No breath inside the first sentence. Full stop at one, a normal breath, and the close starts as its own phrase. No breath inside the close, either between is and still or after still. Full stop at goal, and the take ends with no tail.
lines.reason: Qualify, then resolve. The search ring at s8-event-2 finds no installed station, and the first sentence says so. The close lands on still while the goal pin hovers and does not land at s9-event-1, so the picture and the closing phrase answer the same open question without implying approval. See flags G7 and G8.
